_readme: Optional commercial data per species, keyed by species code. Fill it in as it becomes available. price: {value, unit, currency}. availability: 'stock' | 'produce' | 'na'. applications: free-text list added to the use-class based applications. description: free text, searchable. Note: this file is public. Prices and stock that must stay private belong in a Supabase table with access rules instead. Availability was set from the species Excel: red rows = available to be produced, CDRI and ANPE = in stock, all others N/A. applications: list of application ids (ap0..ap19, see portal-lite.js) that REPLACES the ones derived from the use class; tags: free-text extras shown on the card; image: optional URL, otherwise portal/data/img/<CODE>.jpg is used when it exists. Applications and descriptions for ANPE, CDRI, CUPI, LOGA, LOPR, PEQU, TAUV, LIMB and SORR come from Development_overview.xlsx (2026-09-25). Descriptions are commercial drafts: hand-written for species with a market story, otherwise built from the specifications. Edit freely.
